purpose: Technical preview for a live 2.5D rig rendered into the 2D battlefield with separate skinned body and weapon nodes.
camera: live orthographic camera pitched downward exactly 45 degrees; shared with body rig, weapon, shadow, and preview capture
facing: continuous vertical-axis rotation driven by the live 2.5D rig; screen-right is zero degrees
lighting: shared live cyan key/rim and restrained magenta fill with opaque PBR-styled tactical materials
prompt: Create a technical game-character preview board for a live 2.5D rig while preserving the approved compact armored player identity and tactical graphic look. Show front, side, back, and diagonal views from one strict 45-degree top-down orthographic camera, plus an exploded layer demonstration of opaque skinned body rig, separately attached rifle, hand socket, muzzle socket, and contact shadow. The same model and materials rotate continuously; both hands grip the rifle naturally and occlusion changes with facing. No labels or text.
revision_prompt: Preserve the sheet and change only the isolated rifle: use the exact strict 45-degree orthographic projection and yaw of the assembled bottom-right player while retaining the hand and muzzle socket markers.
negative_constraints: no billboard or screen-space texture projection
no floating, orbiting, or yo-yo weapon
no translucent material or inconsistent view identity
no text, border artifacts, cropped anatomy, or extra characters

references.role: weapon design reference; rebuild as a camera-consistent attached model
